title: iPhone held by iphone-runner, unused for 5 min while 2 jobs wait

messages.text:
iphone-runner has held the iPhone lease for 5 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 12:48Z, a phone run seen by the idle alarm). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: cd-roll-ca (owner fix-cd-roll-ca; its note names the phone); hero-exit-threaded (owner fix-hero-exit-threaded; its wait names the phone).
iphone-runner: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner iphone-runner) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).

history.note: the user is on iphone-runner's step
